patterns.title: Grounded Frontline Quotations, Exact Lead Times & Instant Human Handover
patterns.standard_playbook: Answer frontline product, dimension quote, and active order status inquiries strictly from tenant-approved knowledge entries and live DB rows, switching immediately to human_active whenever a customer requests human assistance.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Never invent unlisted prices, stock, or order numbers; always honor active conversation takeover state before sending any AI reply.
